: Malaria Chemoprevention medicine in Elimination Area.

blocks.text: : Malaria Chemoprevention medicine in Elimination Area.

Intermittent preventive treatment of malaria in pregnancy (IPTp) with Sulfadoxine +Pyrimethamine (SP) is recommended for all pregnant women (except in very low transmission areas) in councils according to the malaria risk stratification and engaged in Malaria Case Based Surveillance (mCBS).

blocks.text: The Medicine of choice for IPTp is SP. It is recommended at each scheduled antenatal care visit. The first IPTp-SP dose should be administered as early as possible during the 2nd trimester of pregnancy and repeated at four weekly intervals until the time of delivery
